_comment: Source registry: what SportsBot collects. Loaded by sportsbot_pipelines.collectors.registry and mirrored into the `sources` table.
Rules: RSS and official APIs first; page extraction only where robots.txt and the terms allow it.
`verified` becomes true only after `make sources-check` fetched the feed; record the date in `notes`.
`domains`: article links outside these domains are dropped.
`sitemaps` + `sitemap_include` (regex on the URL) enable `make backfill`; find sitemap URLs with `make sources-sitemaps`.
`listing` (paginated section pages + an article URL regex) also feeds `make backfill`, for sites whose article URLs have no section path.
Full text is for internal processing only; users see title, excerpt and link.

sources.name: VnExpress Thể thao
sources.notes: Used by the prototype (PR #1). Live check 2026-11-02 from Vietnam (TMK, macOS): 60 entries, all dated with offsets. From a GitHub runner in the US the feed returns HTTP 404, so collect from Vietnam. Backfill: article URLs are flat (no section path), so the sitemap cannot be filtered; the paginated /the-thao section is walked instead (format the-thao-pN seen on page 2, 2026-11-03).

sources.name: Tuổi Trẻ Thể thao
sources.notes: Used by the prototype (PR #1). Live check 2026-11-02: 50 entries. Dates are US month-first with AM/PM and no offset (e.g. 11/2/2026 1:35:00 PM); parsed by collectors/dates.py with Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh assumed. Backfill: flat article URLs. /the-thao/trang-N.htm returns the same items for every N (first backfill found only 42), so the listing walks the section timeline /timeline/1209/trang-N.htm instead (page 5 checked 2026-11-03: sports articles from earlier days).
